equivalence.statement: At fixed n, f = n/(n + NC exp(-d/kT)); NC -> NC/r is identical to every trap depth d -> d + kT ln r (deeper). For the exponential tail this is NTA -> NTA r^(kT/WTA); for the Gaussians EGA -> EGA + kT ln r. In the non-degenerate limit the free-carrier part is a rigid band shift kT ln r (absorbed by Q_f).
